# Client and chains

:::caution[v3 release candidate, unreleased]

This is the reference for `@obolnetwork/obol-sdk@3.0.0-rc.12`, generated from its source and spec. Names and shapes may still change before 3.0.0, and it is not on npm `latest`. For the released SDK see the [2.x reference](../../sdk/index.md).

:::

One client binds every module to one chain, a viem `PublicClient`, an optional `WalletClient` (for EIP-712 signatures and `send`) and the Obol API (or `api: false` for chain-only). Mainnet (1) and Hoodi (560048) have the Obol contracts; Gnosis (100) and Sepolia (11155111) are accepted for cluster files and terms only. Each module is also its own entry point (`@obolnetwork/obol-sdk/ovm`, …) with `createObolContext` and `create<Module>Module`, so a page that needs one module loads only that one.

## Pure helpers {#group-helpers}

### createObolClient {#createObolClient}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag" title="Where it reads from (spec tag)">constructor</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--pure" title="Exported from the namespace, not bound on the client">namespace only</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--throws">throws 1</span> <a class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--stage" href="../lifecycle#setup">1. Set up the client</a></div>

createObolClient (spec/operations.md "Client"): `createObolContext` checks
the chain, the viem clients and the API settings, then every module is
bound to that one context.

```ts sdk-signature
createObolClient(
  config: ObolClientConfig,
): ObolClient
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>config</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/client#ObolClientConfig">ObolClientConfig</a></span> |  |
| <code>config.chain</code> | <span class="sdk-type">Chain</span> | viem Chain: mainnet or Hoodi (Gnosis / Sepolia for cluster files only). |
| <code>config.publicClient</code> | <span class="sdk-type">PublicClient</span> |  |
| <code>config.walletClient?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">WalletClient</span> | Needed for EIP-712 signatures and `send`. |
| <code>config.api?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">{ baseUrl?: string; timeoutMs?: number; allowLocal?: boolean } &#124; false</span> | Default: the Obol API at api.obol.tech, 30 s timeout. `false`: chain only. `baseUrl` must be an Obol host; with `allowLocal: true` it may also be `http(s)://localhost[:port]` or `http(s)://127.0.0.1[:port]` (a local obol-api). EIP-712 signatures are sent to that host as bearer tokens, so any other host is refused. |

</div>

**Returns** <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/client#ObolClient">ObolClient</a></span>

**Throws** <span class="sdk-muted">(per spec)</span> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#BASE_URL_INVALID">BASE_URL_INVALID</a> <span class="sdk-muted">plus the [checks every operation runs](../errors.md#checks-every-operation-runs)</span>

**Example**

```ts
import { createObolClient } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk';
import { createPublicClient, createWalletClient, custom, http } from 'viem';
import { hoodi } from 'viem/chains';

const obol = createObolClient({
  chain: hoodi,
  publicClient: createPublicClient({ chain: hoodi, transport: http() }),
  walletClient: createWalletClient({ chain: hoodi, transport: custom(window.ethereum!) }), // optional
  // api: false, // chain-only; the default is the Obol API at api.obol.tech
});
```

<details class="sdk-spec">
<summary>Specification: createObolClient</summary>

Tag: constructor. Inputs:

```
{ chain: Chain, publicClient: PublicClient, walletClient: WalletClient?,
  api: { baseUrl: string?, timeoutMs: uint?, allowLocal: bool? } | false   # default: the Obol API for the chain, 30000 ms }
```

Checks:

1. `chain.id` is 1, 560048, 100 or 11155111, else [`UNSUPPORTED_CHAIN`](../errors.md#UNSUPPORTED_CHAIN). 100 and 11155111 allow only cluster,
   terms and pure operations (G2). (2.15 `SUPPORTED_CHAIN_IDS`)
2. `publicClient.chain.id` equals `chain.id`, else [`CHAIN_MISMATCH`](../errors.md#CHAIN_MISMATCH). (new; design "Client")
3. If `walletClient.chain` is set, it equals `chain.id`, else [`CHAIN_MISMATCH`](../errors.md#CHAIN_MISMATCH). Re-checked before every signature and
   `send` (G3), because wallets switch chains.
4. `api.baseUrl`, after removing trailing `/`, is one of `https://api.obol.tech`,
   `https://obol-api-nonprod-dev.dev.obol.tech`, `https://obol-api-nonprod-qa.dev.obol.tech`, or, only with
   `api.allowLocal: true`, `http(s)://localhost[:port]` or `http(s)://127.0.0.1[:port]` (no path; a local obol-api),
   else [`BASE_URL_INVALID`](../errors.md#BASE_URL_INVALID). EIP-712 signatures are sent as bearer tokens, so they only go to Obol hosts or to a local
   API the caller opted into. (2.15; `allowLocal` new in 3.0.0-rc.4)
5. `api.timeoutMs` is a finite integer ≥ 0 (0 = no timeout), else [`PAYLOAD_INVALID`](../errors.md#PAYLOAD_INVALID). (2.15)

Output: the client, `{ chain, cluster, deposits, ovm, splits, setup, incentives, exits, terms, withdrawals, send,
experimental: { simulate, legacy } }`. `createObolContext(config)` runs the same checks and returns the context
without the modules; each module entry (`@obolnetwork/obol-sdk/ovm`, `/splits`, … with `create<Module>Module`) binds
one module to it, so an app that needs one module does not load the others (no BLS or SSZ code for `ovm` reads).

<p class="sdk-muted">From <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/spec/operations.md">spec/operations.md</a>.</p>

</details>

<p class="sdk-see">See also: <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/spec/operations.md#createobolclient">spec/operations.md</a> · <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/src/client.ts#L69">source</a></p>

### createObolContext {#createObolContext}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--pure" title="Exported from the namespace, not bound on the client">namespace only</span> <a class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--stage" href="../lifecycle#setup">1. Set up the client</a></div>

Checks the configuration and builds the context every module is bound to.

```ts sdk-signature
createObolContext(
  config: ObolClientConfig,
): Context
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>config</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/client#ObolClientConfig">ObolClientConfig</a></span> |  |
| <code>config.chain</code> | <span class="sdk-type">Chain</span> | viem Chain: mainnet or Hoodi (Gnosis / Sepolia for cluster files only). |
| <code>config.publicClient</code> | <span class="sdk-type">PublicClient</span> |  |
| <code>config.walletClient?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">WalletClient</span> | Needed for EIP-712 signatures and `send`. |
| <code>config.api?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">{ baseUrl?: string; timeoutMs?: number; allowLocal?: boolean } &#124; false</span> | Default: the Obol API at api.obol.tech, 30 s timeout. `false`: chain only. `baseUrl` must be an Obol host; with `allowLocal: true` it may also be `http(s)://localhost[:port]` or `http(s)://127.0.0.1[:port]` (a local obol-api). EIP-712 signatures are sent to that host as bearer tokens, so any other host is refused. |

</div>

**Returns** <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/client#Context">Context</a></span>

**Example**

```ts
import { createObolContext } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk';
import { createOvmModule } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk/ovm';
import { hoodi } from 'viem/chains';

// Load one module only: no BLS or SSZ code for OVM reads.
const ovmModule = createOvmModule(createObolContext({ chain: hoodi, publicClient }));
const state = await ovmModule.getState(ovmAddress); // null when the address is not an OVM
```

| <code>chain.contracts?</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/client#ChainContracts">ChainContracts</a></span> | Absent on chains supported for cluster files only. |
| <code>nowMs?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">number</span> |  |

</div>

**Returns** <span class="sdk-type">bigint &#124; undefined</span>

**Example**

## Module entry points {#module-entry-points}

Each module is its own entry point. Bind one module to a context instead of building the whole client, so a page loads only that module's code (an `ovm` reads-only import has no BLS or SSZ code):

```ts
import { createObolContext } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk';
import { createOvmModule } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk/ovm';
import { hoodi } from 'viem/chains';

// Load one module only: no BLS or SSZ code for OVM reads.
const ovmModule = createOvmModule(createObolContext({ chain: hoodi, publicClient }));
const state = await ovmModule.getState(ovmAddress); // null when the address is not an OVM
```
